description: Check a CONTRIBUTING document against the repository's actual contribution gates, from caller-supplied document text and gate facts. Returns the documented gates, the missing gates, supplied topics that match no gate, a coverage percentage, and a verdict.

document.description: The contributing document text to check

documented_topics.description: Topics the caller extracted from the document, checked against the gate set (optional)

keywords.description: Alternative phrases that also count as documenting the gate (optional)

label.description: Gate label as it would appear in the document

name: check_contributing_coverage
